Join us in Bucaramanga, Colombia on June 19th for the “Data Agents + Visual Agents Hackathon” — a hackathon focused on building the next generation of AI-native workflows with visual AI, agents, and multimodal systems 🇨🇴

Register here: https://lnkd.in/g64JfxuF

Hosted by Diego Tarazona Pinzón from Campuslands and AdonAI Vera from Voxel51, we’ll be bringing together developers, AI engineers, builders, and researchers to experiment with:

🤖 AI agents and MCP-powered workflows
👁️ Visual AI and multimodal applications
🧠 Foundation models for image and video understanding
⚡ Rapid prototyping with real-world datasets and tooling
🌎 Collaborative building with the local AI community

Construyendo el futuro de la Physical AI juntos.
